No Result View All Result Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us Hausa Edition Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us No Result View All Result No Result View All Result Ikoyi Club Set For 3rd NNPC-SNEPCo Inter-schools Swimming Competition by LEADERSHIP News 17 seconds ago in Sport Share on WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X Telegram Preparations have been completed for the third edition of the NNPC-SNEPCo Inter-Schools Swimming Competition, scheduled to hold on Saturday, 24 October, at Ikoyi Club 1938, Lagos.
The competition, sponsored by Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPC) and Shell Nigeria Exploration and Production Company Limited (SNEPCo), in collaboration with Ikoyi Club 1938, is aimed at promoting swimming and developing young sporting talent among schoolchildren across Lagos State.
Chairman of the club’s Swimming Section, Akin Onabolu, confirmed that preparations for the event had been concluded, expressing appreciation to the sponsors for sustaining the initiative.
He said the competition had continued to provide young swimmers with an opportunity to demonstrate their abilities, build confidence and develop an interest in the sport.
“We are grateful to NNPC and SNEPCo for their commitment to this initiative. Their support goes beyond sponsoring a competition. It is an investment in young people, the development of swimming talent and the creation of opportunities for children to discover and fulfil their potential,” Onabolu said.
He added that the partnership had been instrumental in sustaining the competition, noting that participating swimmers were eager to showcase their abilities.
“The swimmers are eager to compete, and we look forward to an exciting day of racing and outstanding performances,” he said.
The competition will feature races in the backstroke, breaststroke, butterfly, freestyle and individual medley, alongside team events.
Participants will compete for medals and recognition, with the event providing an opportunity for young athletes to test their skills against their peers and gain valuable competitive experience.
Beyond the races, the initiative highlights the importance of grassroots sports development and sustained investment in young athletes.
Through their partnership with Ikoyi Club 1938, NNPC and SNEPCo are supporting efforts to identify and nurture emerging swimming talent while encouraging schoolchildren to embrace physical activity and competitive sport.
The organisers expect schools and their swimmers to converge on the Lagos club for a day of competition aimed at celebrating sporting excellence and encouraging the next generation of Nigerian swimmers.
